purpose: Reproducible browser evidence using fictional customers and illustrative evidence; not customer feedback or a real security assessment.

screenshots.title: Fictional fleet intake
assertions: Eight demo sites across four clients.
Status counts are 2 action, 3 verification, 2 complete, 1 provider.
Demo banner is visible.

screenshots.title: Unresolved work stays in the queue
assertions: Queue contains five unresolved records.
Neither completed evidence nor provider-confirmed records appears in the queue.

screenshots.title: One customer, two environments
assertions: Client filter returns only Fern & Field.
The storefront requires action while the booking portal has complete evidence.

screenshots.title: An outdated runtime has an explicit next action
assertions: The saved 8.4.26 storefront is action-required.
Its action plan references the 8.4.27 upstream minimum.

screenshots.title: A patched CLI version is insufficient
assertions: 8.4.27 was saved, but the observation is CLI-only.
Missing restart and application-check evidence leaves the record unresolved.

screenshots.title: Complete recorded evidence survives reload
assertions: Active web runtime, reviewer, evidence note, restart and application check are saved.
Restart 13:30 UTC precedes observation 13:40 UTC and smoke check 13:50 UTC.
The reloaded record is evidence-complete; the workspace is still explicitly a demo.

screenshots.title: Provider confirmation retains its own evidence trail
assertions: A managed-hosting assertion is provider-confirmed, not upstream runtime evidence-complete.
The reference, reviewer, timestamp and explicit coverage of both CVEs are recorded.

screenshots.title: Review a merge before changing inventory
assertions: The preview identifies the imported file as fictional demo data.
Merge by record ID is selected before submission; current inventory has not changed yet.

screenshots.title: A rejected import preserves the nine-site workspace
assertions: Unsupported schemaVersion is rejected visibly.
Parsed stored inventory is unchanged under deep comparison; all nine records remain.

screenshots.title: Customer handover has an explicit scope
assertions: The report is scoped to Fern & Field: three sites, one unresolved.
The dialog discloses fictional demo data before downloading.

screenshots.title: The actual downloaded HTML report renders independently
assertions: This is the file downloaded from the interface, rendered from disk in a new browser tab.
Exactly three Fern & Field records: two complete, one unresolved.
Other customers are absent from the exported HTML; the demonstration warning is visible.

screenshots.title: An explicit empty start removes fictional records
assertions: The user confirmed clearing the workspace.
Zero sites and zero positive outcomes; the next action is to add or import inventory.
No fictional record was silently converted into a real customer record.

screenshots.title: The dated advisory baseline is inspectable
assertions: Catalog ID, review date, expiry, evidence window, CVE scope and upstream minimum versions are shown.
Five primary reference links are present; this is identified as a dated snapshot.

screenshots.title: The overview works in a 390-pixel viewport
assertions: The four status cards and demo banner are visible in the mobile layout.
Document and scrolling-element widths do not exceed the viewport.

screenshots.title: A mobile edit is contained and can be cancelled
assertions: The drawer and its fields fit the mobile viewport; Save and Cancel remain reachable.
The visible name change is an unsaved draft.

screenshots.title: An expired catalog prevents positive outcomes
assertions: Separate test browser clock: 2026-10-29T00:59:59.000Z.
The review-required notice is visible.
Even fresh demo evidence receives no complete or provider-confirmed outcome while the catalog is expired.
